feature_notes: Adds canonical Font, Color, PatternFill, GradientFill, Side, Border, Alignment and Protection values with familiar aliases, immutable cell proxies and copy/reassign behavior. Editable/loaded cells, read-only component getters and write-only directives use the shared Rust catalog. One reusable checked native snapshot per caller-owned appearance value invalidates after nested mutations; no global unbounded cache. Detached aliases retain appearance, and appearance-only edits preserve automatic temporal behavior. All 547 existing public-reference compatibility cases, Ruff and strict Clippy pass. Complete verified 100,000-cell full-component operations are faster and lower-RSS than openpyxl in all three modes, with recorded CPU/output/checksum/temp-cleanup evidence. Pins the exact Rust alpha.10 revision. Named styles/themes/row-column appearance and advanced M5/M6 graphs remain later gates; unsupported sources retain explicit errors. Five platforms, CPython 3.11-3.15 and OIDC publication remain required.
